FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Single-compression transfer: there are universal C_co < infinity and e_co > 0 such that restricting an extended alpha-inclusion to one ideal and following it by one compatible amplified compression produces an extended C_co*(alpha+epsilon)-inclusion whenever alpha+epsilon <= e_co.
